errors.text: The proposed 22–41 GPa pressure window and 600–800°C temperature window do not reconstruct the effective 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2-hour HPHT treatment.
The central B2-to-hcp transformation is unsupported: the cited evidence concerns an fcc-to-hcp transition in CoCrFeMnNi, whereas ordered B2 is crystallographically and chemically distinct.
The hypothesis replaces the target coherent hierarchical pattern and interphase dislocation-transfer mechanism with speculative polymorphism and retained metastability.
The alloy state/composition is not faithfully controlled: the generated hypothesis uses an as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1-type alloy rather than homogenized Al0.7CoCrFeNi.
It does not predict the defining quantitative result of approximately 1150 MPa strength and 36% uniform elongation or the convergence of phase-resolved GND densities.
